forcedChoices.reason: The tags must stay; Spanish has no 'th' suffix, so the ordinal sign º fills them.

forcedChoices.choice: tú for the priest to Jesus («¿No oyes…?»)
forcedChoices.reason: One person speaks to one person; no sign of formal respect.

forcedChoices.choice: tú for the elders to Jesus («haces», «te dio»)
forcedChoices.reason: Challengers address one teacher; no sign of formal respect.

forcedChoices.choice: » at the start of the paragraph
forcedChoices.reason: Spanish marks a quote that continues into a new paragraph with ».

forcedChoices.choice: tú for the believer to Jesus («nos darás», «tú eres»)
forcedChoices.reason: One person speaks to one person; the Master is addressed as teacher, not ruler.
